R2B-deer-backcountry-0005.name: 430 m N of Southgate River
R2B-deer-backcountry-0005.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).
R2B-deer-backcountry-0005.parkWhat: pull off on South Southgate Ml (gravel road)

evidence.t: Deer here are black tailed deer, the coast form of mule deer: the synopsis calls them "mule (black-tailed) deer" (99%, Rule Book: Region 2 Lower Mainland).
No official deer winter range within 500 m, so the top score here is 8 of 11. This score leans on cutblocks, burns, habitat zone and aspect.
Cutblock harvested 2017 (9 years old), 60 m E.
Burn from 2018 (fire V52370, 1,101 ha), right here.
Habitat zone Coastal Western Hemlock (CWHds1): coast forest, where black tailed deer are among the most common large mammals (95%) and use logged ground often (80%) (lesson: Wet forests).
SW facing slope, 13 degrees: sun melts snow first.
Private fields 300 m E: deer feed on field edges (fields are private).
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

flags.t: Private land 300 m E: no shooting within 100 m (109 yd) of an occupied house or farm building (synopsis page 10, 99%).

plan: Drive: from District of Squamish, about 219 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 50.88357, -124.78011, pull off on South Southgate Ml (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 5.8 km E, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 171 m, about 134 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 90 m S of the spot at 26 m (50.87003, -124.69959). Water: Southgate River 340 m S (estimate).
Hunt: deer, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Watch the edge of the 2017 cutblock (60 m E) at first and last light. Sit above it with the wind in your face and glass (Tip).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 165 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 2-14, Region 2. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-09, closures 2026-10-16.
R2B-deer-backcountry-0005.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 2-14: about 98 hunter days a year for mule deer and white tailed deer (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.03 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
